verdict.rationale: AutoGen is a multi-agent framework, not a standalone agent, so shipping an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The only MCP evidence shows an AutoGen agent consuming the third-party Playwright MCP server, which is client-side use. Nothing shows AutoGen itself publishing or running an official MCP server that external agents can connect to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
